findings.description: The separator expression was inverted to `"; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`, so the joiner for the help left column is swapped compared with the original `"; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with more than one spelling, such as `-v, --verbose` (no slash prefix, so any_prefix_is_slash is False). The original code joined the groups with " / ", but the new expression yields "; ", so the rendered help becomes `-v; --verbose`. Options with slash prefixes like `/debug` get the opposite swap. Impact: every option's help left column in --help output changes from the established format, which is a silent regression in user-visible output that the commit title does not announce.
